description:
**Project Role :** Application Support Engineer  

**Project Role Description :** Act as software detectives, provide a dynamic service identifying and solving issues within multiple components of critical business systems.
  

**Must have skills :** Network Security Operations  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **3** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

We are seeking a skilled Network Engineer with strong expertise in network infrastructure and security technologies. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining network systems to ensure high availability, security, and performance..  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Design, configure, and maintain network infrastructure including firewalls, routers, switches, and load balancers.
* Manage and troubleshoot firewall platforms such as Cisco ASA, Fortinet, and Palo Alto.
* Implement and support routing and switching solutions for enterprise networks.
* Configure and optimize load balancers (Citrix NetScaler, F5\) for application delivery and high availability.
* Develop and maintain network automation scripts using Python and Ansible to streamline operations.
* Monitor network performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement solutions to improve reliability and security.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate network solutions with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, OCI).
* Ensure compliance with security standards and best practices.

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Hands\-on experience with firewall technologies: Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto.
* Strong knowledge of routing and switching protocols (BGP, OSPF, VLAN, STP).
* Expertise in load balancer configuration (Citrix NetScaler, F5\).
* Proficiency in network automation tools: Python, Ansible or any other tool.
* Familiarity with cloud networking concepts (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, OCI) – added advantage.
* Excellent troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong communication and documentation abilities.

  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Network Security Operations.
* Relevant certifications (CCNP, Fortinet NSE, Palo Alto PCNSE, F5 Certified, Netscaler or any Cloud \& Automation Certification) preferred
* This position is based at our Gurugram office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

3\. Demurrage Mitigation: Monitoring customs processes closely to ensure zero unplanned or unbudgeted detention and demurrage costs.

2\.Team Player: Collaborative mindset to synchronize effectively with a multi\-layered internal operating network.
  

3\.People Development: Commitment to identifying staff capability gaps, managing training goals, and mentoring team talent.

As the **world’s largest** manufacturer of motorcycles and scooters for the last **25 years**, Hero is where you will get to work with the brightest innovators, passionate about being the best in what they do. If you are someone who dreams big and goes after their dreams with absolute conviction, Hero is your place to be. At Hero, we are building a cutting\-edge future of mobility, pushing frontiers of innovation and aiming for the very best. **Choose to be with the best, choose to be your best.**

title: Senior Threat Hunting & Incident Response Engineer
description:
Gurugram · Full\-time · Senior
#### **About The Position**


**Job Description**


Snowbit is a cybersecurity technology innovator with a vision to empower organizations across the globe to quickly, efficiently, and cost\-effectively ready themselves to address omnipresent cyber risk. Built off years of Israeli cybersecurity experience, Snowbit is looking to offer the broadest managed detection and response offering available today. Snowbit is part of the Coralogix group, with Coralogix rebuilding the path to observability by offloading the burden of indexing and providing deep insights, at an infinite scale, for less than half the cost.

**Snowbit** is looking for an experienced **Senior Threat Hunting \& Incident Response Engineer** to join our Managed Detection and Response (MDR) team. This role requires expertise in incident response, threat hunting, with a strong emphasis on cloud environments and Kubernetes. You will lead efforts to protect our customers from advanced cyber threats while contributing to the continuous improvement of Snowbit’s methodologies, processes, and technology stack.

**Role snapshot**


We are hiring a senior engineer to run proactive threat hunts and deliver log\-based incident analysis across our customers' Coralogix environments. The role sits in the Threat Detection \& Response (TDR) team and exists because hunt coverage is constrained by analyst hours, not by data. We are closing that gap by building agentic hunting capability, so this hire both hunts and builds the systems that hunt.

**About the team**


TDR's scope is threat hunting, incident response support and threat intelligence. We own detection engineering and proactive hunting rather than queue\-driven alert triage. This is a build\-and\-investigate role, where the work is forming the hypothesis, proving or disproving it in the data, and turning what we learn into durable detection logic.


We work across multiple customer Coralogix tenants, each with its own log sources, naming conventions and data quality. A hunt written once has to be adapted, validated and re\-run per environment, which is where most of the craft lives.


#### **Requirements**


**What you'll do**


The role splits roughly 40% proactive hunting, 25% detection engineering, 20% incident analysis support and reporting, and 15% building the agentic tooling that makes the first three scale. That mix shifts during active customer incidents.

**Proactive threat hunting**

* Develop and run hypothesis\-driven hunts across cloud, identity, endpoint and network telemetry in customer Coralogix tenants.
* Translate threat intelligence, MITRE ATT\&CK techniques and post\-incident lessons into testable hunt hypotheses with defined data requirements and success criteria.
* Build and maintain a reusable hunt library so a hunt proven in one environment can be re\-run in another with known adaptations.
* Establish baselines for normal behaviour per environment and identify the deviations worth escalating.

**Detection engineering**

* Write, tune and validate detection rules and alert definitions, with documented logic, expected false\-positive profile and response guidance.
* Measure detection coverage against ATT\&CK and close the gaps that matter most for each customer's threat profile.
* Reduce alert noise by improving rule precision rather than raising thresholds, and evidence the improvement.

**Incident response support**

* Perform log\-based analysis during customer incidents: reconstruct timelines, scope affected identities and assets, and establish what the evidence does and does not support.
* Identify indicators of compromise and pivot across data sources to find related activity.
* Hand the customer's IR team a defensible evidence package and clear, prioritised recommendations.

**Building agentic threat hunting**

* Turn manual hunts into agentic ones: encode a hypothesis, its queries, its pivots and its scoring into a workflow that runs repeatedly across tenants without an analyst driving each step.
* Build and extend the orchestration layer (specialist agents per log source, a correlation layer that links findings across identity, cloud and network telemetry, and a customer context layer that keeps each tenant's baselines distinct).
* Connect models to security data through MCP servers and clients, and package repeatable procedures as reusable skills the whole team can run.
* Define the human checkpoints: what an agent may do unattended, what requires analyst verification before it reaches a customer, and how every finding traces back to source evidence.
* Evaluate the system over time (false positives, unsupported conclusions, query and prompt drift) and improve it against that evidence rather than impressions.

**Reporting and enablement**

* Produce customer\-facing analysis reports in clear, non\-sensational language that distinguishes confirmed findings from assessments.
* Feed detection and logging gaps found during hunts back into onboarding and coverage recommendations.
* Mentor less experienced analysts on query technique, evidence handling and analytic rigour.

**What you'll need**


1\. 4 – 8 years in threat hunting, detection engineering, SOC analysis or DFIR, with at least two spent on proactive hunting or detection content rather than queue triage alone.


2\. Fluency in a log query language \- Dataprime, KQL, SPL, Lucene, SQL or equivalent. You should be able to write multi\-stage aggregations, joins and time\-window correlations without reaching for a template.


3\. You build with AI, not just alongside it. You have shipped something real (an agent, an MCP server or client, a tool\-calling workflow, an LLM\-driven enrichment or triage pipeline) and you can explain where it worked, where it failed and how you knew the difference. If you have automated a hunt or an investigation this way, lead with it.


4\. Working command of MITRE ATT\&CK as an analytic tool: mapping observed behaviour to techniques, and reasoning about coverage gaps, not just tagging rules after the fact.


5\. Demonstrable incident analysis experience: timeline reconstruction, scoping, pivoting across sources, and separating what the evidence proves from what it suggests.


6\. Written communication that stands up to customer scrutiny. You will write reports read by security leaders and sometimes by auditors. Clarity, accurate hedging and no unearned certainty.


7\. Analytic discipline, you state your confidence level, you note what would disprove your hypothesis, you verify AI\-generated conclusions against source data, and you are comfortable concluding that nothing was found.


8\. Comfort working across multiple tenants with inconsistent data quality, partial log coverage and no ability to change the source systems.


9\. This is a work from Office role in Gurugram.

**Cultural Fit**


We’re seeking candidates who are hungry, humble, and smart. Coralogix fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, where team members are encouraged to challenge the status quo and contribute to our shared mission. If you thrive in dynamic environments and are eager to shape the future of observability solutions, we’d love to hear from you.


Coralogix is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

You might already recognize our logo. The REA brand does have an existing presence in India. In fact, we set up our new tech hub in Gurugram to be their neighbours!


REA Group holds a controlling interest in REA India Pte. Ltd., operator of established brands Housing.com, Makaan.com and PropTiger.com, three of the country’s leading digital property marketplaces.


Through our close connection to REA India, we’ve seen first\-hand the incredible talent the country has to offer, and the huge opportunity to expand our global workforce. Our Cyber City Tech Center is an extension of REA Group; a satellite office working directly with our Australia HQ on local projects and tech delivery.

About REA
At REA, we are shaping the future of real estate. Our engineering teams are the architects behind the experiences that millions of property seekers rely on every day. We use the latest technology to deliver best\-in\-class experiences to our customers.



Job Description**Senior Engineer \- EDGE**

**About REA Group:**


In 1995, in a garage in Melbourne, Australia, REA Group was born from a simple question: “Can we change the way the world experiences property”


Could we Yes. Are we done Never.


Fast forward 30 years, REA Group is a market leader in online real estate in three continents and continuing to grow rapidly across the globe. The secret to our growth is staying true to that ‘day one’ mindset; the hunger to innovate, the ambition to change the world, and the curiosity to reimagine the future.


Our new Tech Center in Cyber City is dedicated to accelerating REA Group’s global technology delivery through relentless innovation. We’re looking for the best technologists, inventors and leaders in India to join us on this exciting new journey.


If you’re excited by the prospect of creating something magical from scratch, then read on.

**What the role is all about:**


We’re seeking a Senior Engineer \- EDGE Platform who will play a pivotal role in shaping and scaling REA’s edge security and content delivery capabilities. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, cloud, networking and security, with a strong focus on building resilient, reusable and well\-governed edge platform capabilities for teams across REA.


You’ll help define and evolve our EDGE platform strategy across CDN, WAF, bot management, DNS and traffic management, while applying platform thinking to create paved\-road solutions that are secure, scalable and simple for product and engineering teams to adopt. You’ll combine deep technical expertise with operational discipline, leveraging automation, observability and incident response practices to improve reliability and customer outcomes.


This is your chance to work on impactful projects that directly influence availability, performance and security for customer\-facing experiences at scale. You’ll work with modern tooling and collaborate with engineers across infrastructure, security and product teams in a large, complex technology environment.


**While no two days are likely to be the same, your typical responsibilities will include:**

* Design, implement and continuously improve edge platform capabilities across CDN, WAF and DDoS protection using Akamai.
* Build and operate bot management capabilities using Kasada to improve protection against automated abuse while preserving customer experience.
* Create reusable infrastructure and platform patterns using Terraform, with a strong platform thinking mindset that enables self\-service, consistency and guardrails for engineering teams.
* Work across AWS, networking, CDN, DNS and traffic management domains to deliver secure, resilient and high\-performing solutions.
* Partner with product, platform, security and development teams to embed edge security and reliability considerations early in the design process.
* Investigate and troubleshoot complex production issues across edge, network and cloud layers, driving remediation and long\-term prevention.
* Strengthen incident response practices through PagerDuty, operational readiness, runbooks, on\-call improvements and service ownership.
* Take accountability for delivery, technical quality and operational outcomes, with clear ownership of team and platform OKRs.

**Who we’re looking for:**

* 4\+ years of experience in platform, network or edge engineering roles, with strong hands\-on delivery in production environments.
* Strong experience with CDN and edge technologies, ideally including Akamai for CDN, WAF and DDoS protection.
* Experience with bot management platforms, ideally Kasada or similar tooling used to mitigate automated abuse.
* Solid experience with AWS and a good understanding of core cloud architecture patterns, networking, DNS, TLS, traffic routing and internet\-facing systems.
* Strong proficiency in Terraform and infrastructure as code, with the ability to design reusable modules, standards and platform abstractions.
* Experience writing production\-quality automation and tooling in Python and/or Go.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues across distributed systems using logs, metrics, tracing and other observability tools.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and influence technical direction.

**Bonus Points for:**

* Experience designing internal platform capabilities that improve developer experience and adoption through self\-service patterns.
* Exposure to edge security policy management, rate limiting, API protection or zero trust patterns.
* Experience in high\-scale internet platforms where performance, availability and abuse prevention are critical.
* Familiarity with compliance, governance or risk controls in cloud and edge environments.

**What we offer:**

* A hybrid and flexible approach to working.
* Transport options to help you get to and from work, including home pick\-up and drop\-off.
* Meals provided on site in our office.
* Flexible leave options including parental leave, family care leave and celebration leave.
* Insurances for you and your immediate family members.
* Programs to support mental, emotional, financial and physical health \& wellbeing.
* Continuous learning and development opportunities to further your technical expertise.

**The values we live by:**

* Our values are at the core of how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. We believe that how we work is equally important as what we do to achieve our goals. This commitment is at the heart of everything we do, from the way we interact with colleagues to the way we serve our customers and communities.

**Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion:**


We are committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity, equity and inclusion. We believe teams with diverse ideas and experiences are more creative, more effective and fuel disruptive thinking \- be it cultural and ethnic backgrounds, gender identity, disability, age, sexual orientation, or any other identity or lived experience. We know diverse teams are critical to maintaining our success and driving new business opportunities. If you've got the skills, dedication and enthusiasm to learn but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

Through our close connection to REA India, we’ve seen first\-hand the incredible talent the country has to offer, and the huge opportunity to expand our global workforce. Our Cyber City Tech Center is an extension of REA Group; a satellite office working directly with our Australia HQ on local projects and tech delivery.


All our brands, across the globe, connect regularly, learn from each other and collaborate on shared value initiatives.


Location
Gurgaon
Experience Range
10 \- 13 years
Must\-have Skills
CDN or WAF

Akamai or Kasada
About REA
At REA, we are shaping the future of real estate. Our engineering teams are the architects behind the experiences that millions of property seekers rely on every day. We use the latest technology to deliver best\-in\-class experiences to our customers.



Job Description**About REA Group:**


In 1995, in a garage in Melbourne, Australia, REA Group was born from a simple question: “Can we change the way the world experiences property?”


Could we? Yes. Are we done? Never.


Fast forward 30 years, REA Group is a market leader in online real estate in three continents and continuing to grow rapidly across the globe. The secret to our growth is staying true to that ‘day one’ mindset; the hunger to innovate, the ambition to change the world, and the curiosity to reimagine the future.


Our new Tech Center in Cyber City is dedicated to accelerating REA Group’s global technology delivery through relentless innovation. We’re looking for the best technologists, inventors and leaders in India to join us on this exciting new journey.


If you’re excited by the prospect of creating something magical from scratch, then read on.

**What the role is all about:**


We’re seeking a Staff Engineer \- EDGE Platform who will play a pivotal role in shaping and scaling REA’s edge security and content delivery capabilities. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, cloud, networking and security, with a strong focus on building resilient, reusable and well\-governed edge platform capabilities for teams across REA.


You’ll help define and evolve our EDGE platform strategy across CDN, WAF, bot management, DNS and traffic management, while applying platform thinking to create paved\-road solutions that are secure, scalable and simple for product and engineering teams to adopt. You’ll combine deep technical expertise with operational discipline, leveraging automation, observability and incident response practices to improve reliability and customer outcomes.


This is your chance to work on impactful projects that directly influence availability, performance and security for customer\-facing experiences at scale. You’ll work with modern tooling and collaborate with engineers across infrastructure, security and product teams in a large, complex technology environment.


**While no two days are likely to be the same, your typical responsibilities will include:**

* Set technical direction for the EDGE platform across CDN, WAF, DDoS protection, bot management, DNS and traffic management, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable and aligned to business priorities.
* Lead the design and evolution of platform capabilities using Akamai and Kasada, making sound architectural decisions that balance security, reliability, performance and developer experience.
* Define and drive reusable platform patterns using Terraform, with strong platform thinking that enables self\-service, consistency, governance and safe adoption across engineering teams.
* Work across AWS, networking, CDN and edge security domains to solve complex end\-to\-end problems and raise the technical maturity of internet\-facing systems.
* Partner closely with product, platform, security and development teams to influence roadmaps, shape designs early and ensure edge capabilities are built as strategic platform services rather than one\-off solutions.
* Improve operational excellence through PagerDuty, incident leadership, runbooks, on\-call practices, service readiness reviews and clear ownership models.
* Define technical standards, guardrails and engineering best practices for the EDGE domain, and ensure they are adopted effectively across teams.
* Own and drive meaningful technology outcomes through OKRs, architecture direction and measurable improvements in security, reliability, performance and platform adoption.
* Mentor engineers, provide technical leadership across team boundaries and help grow a strong engineering culture centred on accountability, ownership and continuous improvement.

**Who we’re looking for:**

* 9\+ years’ experience in cloud platform, SRE, network and edge engineering roles, including strong hands\-on delivery and technical leadership in production environments.
* Deep expertise in CDN and edge technologies, ideally including Akamai for CDN, WAF and DDoS protection, with the ability to make sound architectural and operational trade\-offs.
* Strong experience with bot management platforms such as Kasada, or similar capabilities used to detect and mitigate automated abuse at scale.
* Strong depth in AWS and a broad understanding of networking, DNS, TLS, traffic routing and internet\-facing architectures, with the ability to reason across the full request path.
* Advanced proficiency in Terraform and infrastructure as code, including designing reusable modules, standards, abstractions and governance mechanisms for wider engineering adoption.
* Strong software engineering skills in Python and/or Go, with experience building internal tooling, automation and platform integrations used by multiple teams.
* Proven ability to solve ambiguous, high\-impact technical problems across distributed systems and drive outcomes that improve security, reliability, performance and developer experience.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineers, product, security and leadership stakeholders with varying technical backgrounds.
* A high degree of accountability and ownership, including experience shaping or owning OKRs, driving execution and being responsible for measurable platform outcomes.

**Bonus Points for:**

* Experience designing internal platform capabilities that improve developer experience and adoption through self\-service patterns.
* Exposure to edge security policy management, rate limiting, API protection or zero trust patterns.
* Experience in high\-scale internet platforms where performance, availability and abuse prevention are critical.
* Familiarity with compliance, governance or risk controls in cloud and edge environments.

**What we offer:**

* A hybrid and flexible approach to working.
* Transport options to help you get to and from work, including home pick\-up and drop\-off.
* Meals provided on site in our office.
* Flexible leave options including parental leave, family care leave and celebration leave.
* Insurances for you and your immediate family members.
* Programs to support mental, emotional, financial and physical health \& wellbeing.
* Continuous learning and development opportunities to further your technical expertise.

**The values we live by:**


Our values are at the core of how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. We believe that how we work is equally important as what we do to achieve our goals. This commitment is at the heart of everything we do, from the way we interact with colleagues to the way we serve our customers and communities.

**Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion:**


We are committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity, equity and inclusion. We believe teams with diverse ideas and experiences are more creative, more effective and fuel disruptive thinking \- be it cultural and ethnic backgrounds, gender identity, disability, age, sexual orientation, or any other identity or lived experience. We know diverse teams are critical to maintaining our success and driving new business opportunities. If you've got the skills, dedication and enthusiasm to learn but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. **Work Location:** In Person

**Industry:** Corporate Finance \| Project Finance \| Investment Banking \| Fundraising

About BLACKBULL Group

BLACKBULL Group is expanding its **Corporate Finance and Investment Division** to develop a strong fundraising and capital advisory platform serving corporate and project\-based clients across India.

We are looking for an experienced **Fundraising Consultant** with proven practical expertise in arranging and executing financing transactions. The selected professional will work across sectors including **infrastructure, real estate, manufacturing, healthcare, technology, renewable energy, logistics, hospitality, and MSMEs.**

This position requires a professional who can independently identify funding sources, structure transactions, engage lenders and investors, negotiate financing terms, and drive transactions toward financial closure.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and execute fundraising strategies for corporate and project\-based clients.
* Arrange **Project Finance, Property Finance, Institutional Finance, Working Capital, Term Loans, and Structured Debt**.
* Establish and manage relationships with banks, NBFCs, financial institutions, investment funds, family offices, private equity funds, venture capital firms, and corporate investors.
* Identify appropriate funding sources based on project feasibility, financial requirements, risk profile, and repayment capacity.
* Prepare and review **financial models, business plans, Information Memorandums (IMs), project reports, investment proposals, lender presentations, and funding documentation**.
* Manage the complete fundraising cycle from mandate acquisition and financial structuring through due diligence, sanction, documentation, and financial closure.

* Support **business expansion financing, refinancing, acquisition financing, takeover funding, mergers and acquisitions, and large\-scale capital deployment projects**.
